viz_gaps.reason: This is a full quadrilateral (parallelogram PQRS) scene: four vertices, two sides-vs-diagonals (PR and QS crossing), plus two extra labelled construction points (M, at the diagonals' intersection, and T). coordinate_plot only draws bare points and generic point-to-point segments revealed in one sequence — it has no notion of polygon sides versus diagonals, or of labelled interior/auxiliary points — and geo_scene is scoped to circle geometry (circles, chords, radii, arcs), not general quadrilaterals. Forcing this into either would drop the diagonal/side distinction and the M and T points, or misrepresent the shape as an unordered dot-and-line scatter.
viz_gaps.needed_kind: polygon_scene: labelled polygon vertices, sides and diagonals (plus auxiliary interior points) on a coordinate grid, revealed step by step

meter.record: uv run meter_run.py record --book g10-math --stage S2-S4,S8 --run <runId>
meter.by_stage: uv run meter_run.py summary --book g10-math --by phase
meter.by_lesson: uv run meter_run.py summary --book g10-math --by lesson
meter.note: Phase titles start with their stage (S2, S3, S4, S8), so `--by phase` is the per-stage cost; every label carries the lesson slug (S3:blind:<slug>:1), so `--by lesson` is the per-lesson cost.
